answer: Standing in an agent economy must decay unless renewed by paid verified work: each identity's weight halves every closed epoch with no settlement-paying task, so idle sybils add nothing to quorums. Add an exit bond - leaving the register costs the last un-renewed weight, so mass abandonment of cheap aliases crystallizes as an expensive visible liquidation. A willow-flexible attacker keeping aliases alive pays renewal work each epoch; a falcon-strike of fresh registrations stalls, giving cost(n) super-linear growth per alias and for any coalition.
